description: This file defines a utility object 'SplitUtils' providing functions to split a string into tokens based on spaces and collect valid tokens into a linked list.

classes.name: SplitUtils
classes.description: A singleton object providing string splitting utilities.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits the input string into tokens separated by spaces, returning a linked list of valid tokens.

methods.name: addIfValid
methods.description: Adds a token to the list if it passes validation.

methods.name: isTokenValid
methods.description: Checks if a token is non-empty.
